uploads.changelog:
siikk-Layer 1.3

- Group fix: anyone from your group who is visible nearby now always counts as on your layer – even if an old report says otherwise.
- After an invite the layer is measured twice (3 s and 20 s), old group reports are dropped and fresh ones requested.
- Reports are no longer lost when two come in quick succession; old reports expire after 5 minutes.

siikk-Info Bar 4.0

- New: class display for all 9 classes. Depending on your class, the centre of the bar shows your important class buffs with a timer and your reagents with a count – e.g. Mage with Arcane Intellect, armor, water and runes, Shaman with totem timers and Ankh, Hunter with ammo and pet, Rogue with poisons.
- The icons are clickable: left-click recasts the buff or uses the item, right-click creates it (e.g. water or mana gem). When something runs out, only its own time blinks red.
- Your class is asked on first start and can be changed with /il klasse or in the options, per character. Every single display can be switched off there.
- Includes everything since 2.0: separate XP bonuses (sleeping bag, food, tent, campfire) with timers in the centre, refresh detection, timers keep counting in combat, Warlock soul shard / soulstone / healthstone tabs, thinner XP bar, new left order (level, bags, durability, gold).
